source_en: Good evening! You're new. Nona Beridze, [[census recorder]], district eleven.
Since the blast, the State needs to know who's left. Isn't it exciting?
Of course! Curfews, checkpoints, empty flats. Everything's finally in motion.
The State knows. Isn't that enough? Wanting more is how it starts.
That uniform! You wear the State's uniform! ...Forgive me. It makes you sacred.
You carry out its will. If you don't, {{I'll report you}}. Gladly.
So I'm told. Usually by people whose names I've since passed along.
Thirty-one crossings, stricter every time. I love that. They're paying attention.
